hooks.name: Commit Guard (pre-push)
hooks.description: Runs linting and unit tests for both backend and frontend before pushing code. Acts as a local CI gate.

action.command: bash -c 'cd /home/peter/projects/myAdmin && echo "=== Backend Lint ===" && python -m ruff check backend/ --output-format=concise 2>&1 | tail -n 15 && echo "=== Backend Tests ===" && cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/unit/ -x -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -n 20 && echo "=== Frontend Lint ===" && cd ../frontend && npx eslint --max-warnings=0 --format=compact 2>&1 | tail -n 15 && echo "=== Frontend Tests ===" && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -n 20'
